name: app-6aba40d39cc08191935e49b75512a649
description: Find experiences and reserve day passes to premium hotel pools, spas, beach clubs and cabanas, no overnight stay. Search live availability, prices and reviews; booking completes on DayPass Website.

interface.longDescription: Discover and book day passes — day access to premium hotel pools, beach clubs, spas and cabanas worldwide, no overnight stay — on DayPass. Search by city or country and browse venues as interactive cards and a map, with live availability, prices (incl. child & kid), what's included and guest reviews; each result links to the DayPass booking page. Read-only: booking and payment complete on daypassapp.com.
defaultPrompt: Find a pool experience at a hotel in Dubai for this weekend.
Which cities in Mexico can I book a hotel spa or beach club in for the day?
What's included at a beach club in Mauritius, and the price for 2 adults and 2 kids?

positive.description: Find pool access at hotels in a specific city
positive.prompt: Find a pool experience at a hotel in Dubai for this weekend.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows an interactive card rail of Dubai venues (List/Map toggle): photo, name, rating and review count, experience names, from-price, sold-out badge where applicable, and a Book on DayPass button. The Map view shows venues as price pins.

positive.description: Search a whole small island market
positive.prompt: Which hotels in Mauritius can I book pool or beach access at for the day?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card rail of the live Mauritius venues across the island (about 11), with rating, photo, from-price, availability (some flagged sold out) and a booking button.

positive.description: Find which cities in a large country have experiences
positive.prompt: Which cities in Mexico can I book a hotel spa or beach club in for the day?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Mexican cities with live listings and their venue counts (e.g. Cancún, Los Cabos, Playa del Carmen, Tulum), then asks which city to search instead of searching the whole country.

positive.description: Amenities and family pricing for a venue
positive.prompt: Find a pool experience at a hotel in Dubai. Then, for one of the results: what's included there, and what's the price for 2 adults and 2 kids?
positive.expected_behavior: After the Dubai results, returns the chosen venue's inclusions, hours and adult/child/kid price tiers, plus an indicative total for 2 adults and 2 kids with a booking link. Final total and payment are on the DayPass website.

positive.description: Read guest reviews for a venue
positive.prompt: Show recent guest reviews for Fairmont The Palm in Dubai.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent guest reviews (rating and written feedback, first names only) and the venue's overall rating.

negative.description: Overnight hotel room booking is out of scope (DayPass sells daytime access, no overnight stay)
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel room in Cancún for two nights next weekend.
Find me a cheap flight from London to Dubai.

negative.description: Managing an existing reservation is unsupported (read-only, no account access)
negative.prompt: Cancel my pool booking for tomorrow.

review.commerce_description: Read-only discovery. The plugin does not sell or process payments; booking and payment happen on the DayPass website.

publication.release_notes: Updated logo (DayPass pin icon) and listing translations (Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portuguese). Widget labels shown in the user's language. Shorter replies under the interactive cards, which already show every venue, price and location on their own map. Read-only; booking and payment complete on DayPass.

es-ES.subtitle: Piscinas, spas y beach clubs
es-ES.description: Descubre y reserva acceso de día a piscinas, beach clubs, spas y cabañas de hoteles premium en todo el mundo, sin necesidad de alojarte, en DayPass. Busca por ciudad o país y explora los hoteles en tarjetas interactivas y en un mapa, con disponibilidad en tiempo real, precios (incluidos niños), qué incluye cada experiencia y opiniones de clientes; cada resultado enlaza con la página de reserva de DayPass. Solo lectura: la reserva y el pago se completan en daypassapp.com.

fr-FR.subtitle: Piscines, spas et beach clubs
fr-FR.description: Découvrez et réservez un accès à la journée aux piscines, beach clubs, spas et cabanas d'hôtels haut de gamme partout dans le monde, sans nuitée, sur DayPass. Recherchez par ville ou par pays et parcourez les établissements sous forme de fiches interactives et sur une carte, avec disponibilités en temps réel, tarifs (enfants compris), prestations incluses et avis clients ; chaque résultat renvoie vers la page de réservation DayPass. Lecture seule : la réservation et le paiement se font sur daypassapp.com.

it-IT.subtitle: Piscine, spa e beach club
it-IT.description: Scopri e prenota l'accesso giornaliero a piscine, beach club, spa e cabanas di hotel di alto livello in tutto il mondo, senza pernottamento, su DayPass. Cerca per città o paese e sfoglia le strutture in schede interattive e su una mappa, con disponibilità in tempo reale, prezzi (bambini inclusi), servizi inclusi e recensioni degli ospiti; ogni risultato rimanda alla pagina di prenotazione DayPass. Sola lettura: prenotazione e pagamento si completano su daypassapp.com.

de-DE.subtitle: Hotelpools, Spas, Beachclubs
de-DE.description: Entdecke und buche Tageszugang zu Pools, Beachclubs, Spas und Cabanas erstklassiger Hotels weltweit, ganz ohne Übernachtung, auf DayPass. Suche nach Stadt oder Land und sieh dir die Angebote als interaktive Karten und auf einer Landkarte an, mit Live-Verfügbarkeit, Preisen (inklusive Kinder), Leistungen und Gästebewertungen; jedes Ergebnis führt zur Buchungsseite auf DayPass. Nur Lesezugriff: Buchung und Zahlung erfolgen auf daypassapp.com.

pt-BR.subtitle: Piscinas, spas e beach clubs
pt-BR.description: Descubra e reserve acesso de um dia a piscinas, beach clubs, spas e cabanas de hotéis premium no mundo todo, sem hospedagem, no DayPass. Pesquise por cidade ou país e veja os locais em cards interativos e em um mapa, com disponibilidade em tempo real, preços (incluindo crianças), o que está incluído e avaliações de hóspedes; cada resultado leva à página de reserva do DayPass. Somente leitura: a reserva e o pagamento são concluídos em daypassapp.com.
